entries.question: Mujhe batayen ki kgmu mein paramedical mein admission jaise milta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Paramedical mein admission ke liye, aapko nimnalikhit prakriya se gujarna hoga:

1.  **Paramedical Admission Instructions aur Checklist:** Sabse pehle, aapko KGMU ki official website par "Paramedical Admission (12 to 16 September 2024) Instructions and checklist of Mandatory Documents for Paramedical admission Batch 2024-25" link dekhna hoga. Yahan aapko admission ke liye zaroori nirdesh aur documents ki checklist milegi.

2.  **KGMU Website Check Karen:** Admission process ke liye KGMU ki official website (www.kgmu.org) ko regular check karte rahein. Yahan par aapko latest updates, notifications aur eligibility criteria milenge.

3.  **Entrance Exam:** Paramedical courses mein admission ke liye KGMU ek entrance exam conduct karta hai. Is exam ke liye apply karne ke liye aapko website par diye gaye link ka istemal karna hoga.

4.  **Counseling:** Entrance exam mein qualify hone ke baad, aapko counseling process mein participate karna hoga, jahan aapko seats allot ki jayengi.

5.  **Documents Submission:** Admission ke liye aapko website par di gayi checklist ke anusar saare zaroori documents submit karne honge.

Latest aur sahi jaankari ke liye, KGMU ki official website par diye gaye admission se sambandhit links aur documents ko dhyan se padhna zaroori hai.

entries.question: College me admission kon se students le sakte h
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU) mein vibhinn courses ke liye admission ke liye kuch eligibility criteria hain jo course ke according alag-alag hote hain.

Aam taur par, KGMU mein admission ke liye nimnlikhit chhatra patra ho sakte hain:

*   **MBBS/BDS:** In courses ke liye admission UP state Combined Pre Medical Test (UPCPMT) aur All India Medical Entrance Examination (NEET) ke through hota hai.
*   **Postgraduate Courses (MD/MS/MDS/DM/MCh/PG Diploma):** In courses ke liye admission UPPGMEE aur AIPGMEE (NEET-PG) ke through hota hai.
*   **Paramedical Diploma Courses:** In courses ke liye admission ke liye UP State Medical Faculty dwara conduct kiye jaane wale entrance exam ke through hota hai.
*   **Nursing Courses (B.Sc. Nursing, M.Sc. Nursing):** Inke liye admission alag se hone wale entrance exam ke through hota hai.

Aap KGMU ki official website www.kgmu.org par jaakar "Admissions" section mein vibhinn courses aur unke eligibility criteria ke baare mein vistrit jaankari prapt kar sakte hain. Wahan aapko courses ki list, unke liye avashyak shaikshik yogyata, aur admission process ke baare mein sabhi mahatvapurna jaankari mil jayegi.

Kya aap kisi vishesh course ke baare mein jaanna chahte hain?
